explanations.23: useBlogPost() is a special hook that gives you information about whether you're currently viewing a full blog post page or just seeing a preview card in a list.
explanations.24: The function returns a CSS class name if we're in list view, or undefined (which means no extra styling) if we're viewing the full post page.
explanations.31: This line checks two things: whether the post metadata says it was AI-assisted AND whether we're on the actual post page, then only shows the AI icon if both are true.
explanations.57: The !== false check means 'show this component unless tried_it is explicitly set to false', so it shows by default if the property doesn't exist or is anything other than false.
